name: Aritz Granados
source: A trainee pirate in the Water Valley pirate gang; his life changes when the ring which his deceased mother Carlin bequeathed to him as a keepsake was chosen as one of the rings required to unlock passage to the Coral Sea King. Given temporary command of the pirate gang until he assembles all of the rings and is acknowledged by Barmilo as a fully-fledged member, he agonises over the wish he wants the King to grant.
